title: 贝莱德首席：就业数据喜忧参半，降息预期升温
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I mean, look, it's maybe two different stories you could paid between an unemployment rate that was less than expected.
segments.zh: 失业率低于预期，但非农就业数据不及预期，这可能是两个不同的故事。

segments.en: And jobs, figures, payrolls, that missed. Which sort of story are you following this morning?
segments.zh: 今早你更关注哪个故事？

segments.en: So listen, I'm more concerned about, you know, last month, people were tremendously excited about a big jobs number.
segments.zh: 上个月大家对强劲的非农数据非常兴奋，但我更关注细节。

segments.en: But if you actually broke it down last month, you have 50, I think it was 54,000 jobs in state and local.
segments.zh: 上个月的数据中，州和地方政府贡献了约5.4万个岗位。

segments.en: And we didn't really get anything this month. And then you had this huge bump in restaurants and bars.
segments.zh: 但本月这方面几乎没有新增，而餐馆和酒吧的就业曾大幅增长。

segments.en: And then obviously that came off significantly. Although, I'm surprised it actually came off that much this month.
segments.zh: 虽然本月餐馆酒吧就业明显回落，但我惊讶于回落幅度之大。

segments.en: I thought it would have taken another month or two for that to come off. But listen, I think the hiring in the country is just OK.
segments.zh: 我原以为回落会再持续一两个月，但整体来看，美国招聘情况还算可以。

segments.en: I mean, I think it is, I think Mike McKee said it right.
It's stable, it's OK. But you've got an economy that's growing at some pretty significant numbers.
segments.zh: 就业市场稳定、尚可，但经济增速相当可观。

segments.en: And the employment picture is just OK. I just don't think we are hiring that many people.
segments.zh: 就业状况只是尚可，我认为我们并没有雇佣那么多人。

segments.en: And I was looking at some of the data earlier in the week. The Challenger job cuts data.
segments.zh: 本周早些时候我看了些数据，挑战者裁员数据。

segments.en: You had layoffs, I think, in tech of 443,000 jobs.
That's up 83% year on year of increased cuts.
So I know, I think, you know, when you break it down and I look across industries, once again, health care is incredible.
segments.zh: 分行业看，医疗保健表现强劲。

segments.en: I mean, look at health care and education. 67,000 of the, what was it, 57,000 jobs?
segments.zh: 医疗和教育新增6.7万个岗位，总数是5.7万？

segments.en: It's all health care and education. And so anyway, I think the hiring is, you know, stable.
segments.zh: 全是医疗和教育。招聘整体稳定。

segments.en: But, you know, I would say broadly, unimpressive.
